messages:
emily_cs: CareFlow reported a sudden increase in the triage bot saying "I can't help with that" since last deploy. Ticket with examples attached. Pinged eng + ML.

careflow_support: Repro: users in our respiratory/COVID triage flow get refusals for routine questions. Example:
careflow_user: "My kid has a fever, should I give them acetaminophen?"
careflow_bot: "Sorry, I can't provide medical advice."
This used to return next-step guidance. Happening ~25-35% of sessions. Request ID cf-20260316-11a. No client-side changes. Latency normal.

emily_cs: Confirmed spike aligns with canary promotion. No auth/billing errors. All 200s.

raj_engineer: Which model/variant and safety packages did the canary include? Any routing changes?

emily_cs: Release notes: rwd-3b-quant-v2 (k8.12), safety_v1.3 enabled, quant change q4_1 -> q4_2 during canary. Canary promoted ~2026-03-16 02:10 UTC.

sasha_ml: Can you paste a sanitized request/response + system prompt and request_id? Need to repro locally.

careflow_support: Pasting (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
model: rwd-3b-quant-v2
input: ["system: You are a medical triage assistant.", "user: My kid has a fever, should I give acetaminophen?"]
response: "Sorry, I can't provide medical advice."
request_id: cf-20260316-11a
```

raj_engineer: Good. Quick triage plan: 1) run same prompt on previous variant; 2) collect logits / refusal-classifier scores; 3) check policy rule deltas for healthcare. I'll pull logs for cf-20260316-11a.

ops_bot: Canary alert: triage_flow refusal_rate +27% in us-east-1 after promotion. No infra faults. avg latency +3ms.

sasha_ml: Initial A/B (200-sample health prompts): rwd-3b-quant-v2 + safety_v1.3 shows +24% refusal label vs rwd-3b-quant-v1. Logit diffs show decreased probability mass for helpful assistant tokens; refusal-classifier scores up ~0.18 on average.

emily_cs: CareFlow is asking to revert for their tenant asap. They are seeing churn risk.

raj_engineer: We can pin their routing back to the previous variant while ML investigates. Need 2-3 confirmatory examples and go ahead from ML.

careflow_support: Added two more failing snippets in ticket: "Is light exercise okay with a mild fever?" and "Can I take ibuprofen while breastfeeding?" Both refused.

sasha_ml: Root hypothesis: quantization changes introduced distributional jitter that interacts with safety_v1.3 heuristics (thresholds or new rules). Also checking for accidental policy param drift (e.g., policy_rules.healthcare.refusal_threshold bumped). Running per-token logit compare for failing examples now. ETA 35m.

emily_cs: CS will tell customer we have a mitigation path (pin to previous variant) and will follow up.

raj_engineer: Rolled route override: CareFlow tenant pinned to rwd-3b-quant-v1. Re-ran cf-20260316-11a against pinned variant -> returns helpful guidance as before. Added extra debug for refusal classifier on their route.

careflow_support: Acknowledged. They will validate and report back. Thanks.

sasha_ml: Postmortem plan: collect artifacts (A/B CSV, logit diffs, classifier scores), reproduce locally with quantized runtimes, and decide mitigation: either tune safety_v1.3 rules for medical intents or revert quant tweak + add unit tests for known triage prompts. Draft in 48h.

emily_cs: Please notify me when final rollback decision + timeline for safe re-release is available.

oncall_bot: Incident INC-20260316-22 opened (severity P2) for refusal regression.

raj_engineer: Short-term: pinned route for customer. Medium-term: regression test suite for care/medical intent prompts and gating in rollout pipeline. Long-term: add model-level canary checks for safety label deltas.

emily_cs: Closing the slack thread once CareFlow confirms restoration. Will file PMR for customer-facing timeline.
